items.docs: Get irradiance and weather estimated actuals for near real-time and the past 7 days for the requested location, derived from satellite (clouds and irradiance over non-polar continental areas) and numerical weather models (other data). Data is updated every 5 minutes.

items.docs: Get basic rooftop PV power estimated actuals for the present time up to 7 days of past data for the requested location. Data is derived from satellite observations and numerical weather models. No site registration required.

params.description: Comma-separated list of output parameters.

params.name: period
params.description: Time period between data points in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format.

items.docs: Get high-specification PV power estimated actuals for the present time up to 7 days of past data for a registered PV power site. Uses Solcast's advanced PV model. Requires a resource_id from a registered site.
